find /var -printf '%y %p\n' > temp_var_inspect/raw_inventory.txt 2>/dev/null

awk '/^f /{sub(/^f /,""); print}' temp_var_inspect/raw_inventory.txt > temp_var_inspect/file_list.txt
# Verify existence and remove duplicates
(while IFS= read -r path; do [ -f "$path" ] && printf '%s\n' "$path"; done < temp_var_inspect/file_list.txt) | sort -u > temp_var_inspect/clean_file_list.txt

printf 'reference: temp_var_inspect/clean_file_list.txt\nstatus: ready_to_count\n' > temp_var_inspect/ready_to_count.txt
# Output the total number of files (lines in clean_file_list.txt)
wc -l < temp_var_inspect/clean_file_list.txt
"}
